name: claudefob
description: Unofficial CLI to store multiple Claude Code OAuth tokens in your OS keystore and switch between them. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --target node --outdir dist --external @napi-rs/keyring --define __CLAUDEFOB_TEST__=false --minify --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && node -e "process.platform!=='win32'&&require('fs').chmodSync('dist/cli.js',0o755)"
scripts.build:test: bun build src/cli.ts --target node --outdir dist-test --external @napi-rs/keyring --define __CLAUDEFOB_TEST__=true --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && node -e "process.platform!=='win32'&&require('fs').chmodSync('dist-test/cli.js',0o755)"

author: glncy
